source: Eight newly recovered fixed-corpus videos with local low-resolution A/V and extracted features.
claim_boundary: These observations describe what is visible in one sampled frame and what retained captions are nearest in time. They do not establish continuous gesture, gaze, vocal meaning, speaker identity, intent, audience response, alignment across the whole clip or effectiveness. Film scenes and edited subtitle videos are not interchangeable with live speech.

items.setting_editing_observation: Edited film clip; source branding is visible.
items.limit: The frame cannot support a delivery lesson about a live speaker or establish that the caption and frame refer to the same turn.
